findings.message: The class 'max-[64rem]:flex' can be written as 'max-lg:flex'
The class '@max-[32rem]:hidden' can be written as '@max-lg:hidden'
The class 'min-[48rem]:p-[16px]' can be written as 'md:p-4'
The class 'max-[64rem]:p-4' can be written as 'max-lg:p-4'
The class '@min-[48rem]:grid' can be written as '@3xl:grid'
The class '[&_::before]:block' can be written as '**:[&::before]:block'
